description:
Join us for a dynamic episode of 3ABN Today Bible Q&A as our panel tackles your most pressing Bible questions. One key topic we'll explore: What is the Investigative Judgment? Discover what the Bible says and why does it matters for every believer. Don’t miss this clear and hope-filled explanation of God’s plan of redemption!


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1. Why does God mention a New Heaven and a New Earth? I can completely understand the importance of needing a New Earth but why a New Heaven? 

2.  Revelation 22:5 states there will be no night in Heaven & God never sleeps or slumbers,  so will we sleep in Heaven? Will we sleep in Heaven?

3. What is the difference between the soul, the spirit, and the breath when someone dies? Do these elements return to God upon death, and what does He do with them? 

4.  When Jesus went to Heaven some days after his resurrection, he went into the holy place and according to the Seventh-day Adventist church he moved to the most holy place in 1844. Some refute this because when Jesus died the veil was torn from top to bottom meaning there was no holy place and most holy place any more, but one room since the curtain was removed. Why then are there still endless discussions going on in the church about this? Is the bible not clear on this subject? Did Jesus go to the Holy Place or the Most Holy Place?

5.  The disciples waited until after the Sabbath for the preparation of Jesus' body. Does that mean we shouldn't have funerals or go to funerals on the Sabbath? Should funerals be held on Sabbath?

6. Colossians 2:16 says "Therefore do not let anyone judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a religious festival, a New Moon celebration or a Sabbath day."  Seems to say it does not matter the day that we rest. Can you please explain Colossians 2:16?

7.  Could you explain the seven churches of Revelation? 

8. Does Satan have the power to resurrect the dead to life? 

9. Could you explain 2 Corinthians 12:2? 

10. What is the investigative judgment? 

11. Will I still have eternal life with Christ if I get cremated? 

12. Can you please explain 1 Corinthians 15:51-54?
